description:
Given a verse, find other passages in the library that say something close to it — by meaning, not by shared words. Start here when you already have a verse; when you only have words, a question or a term, use search_texts.

Use it to check whether a teaching appears elsewhere before presenting it as the tradition's position, to gather parallel places, or to see how different works treat one subject. Set `exclude_same_work` when you want an independent witness: the next verse of the same chapter is nearly always similar and proves nothing.

An empty result is a real answer — it means the library says this in one place only.

exclude_same_work.description: Skip passages from the same work, so what comes back corroborates rather than repeats. Default false.

language.description: Preferred language of the translations returned. Not a filter: works that exist only in Russian are returned in Russian, and each result says which language it is actually in. Default: en.

verse.description: A citation ("BG 2.47") or a `unit_id` from an earlier result.

name: find_similar_verses
title: Find parallel passages
